$comment: The static secrets in kv-lance-<env>-<suffix> and which app may read each one (ADR 0022). modules/containerapps.bicep binds every entry with an env name into the apps listed under bind, and modules/keyvault.bicep grants Key Vault Secrets User on that one secret to exactly the apps under bind and sdkRead, and Key Vault Secrets Officer on it to the apps under sdkWrite, so the bindings and the grants are one table and cannot drift. Every entry is created as a placeholder when it is missing and never overwritten when it exists; Dom sets the real values (docs/runbooks/deploy.md step 4). Per-principal credentials are not here: they live in kv-lance-p-<env>-<suffix> (modules/principal-vault.bicep).

secrets.name: jamie-api-key
secrets.source: Legacy: Dom's Jamie key before ADR 0022. The worker copies it once into jamie-api-key--<principalId> in the principal vault.

secrets.name: graph-refresh-token
secrets.source: Legacy: Dom's Graph refresh token before ADR 0022. The worker copies it once into graph-refresh-token--<principalId> in the principal vault and never writes it again; it keeps Secrets Officer here only until the fallback is removed, so a revision of the previous image still running during a deploy can finish its last rotation.
